verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes dedicated framework pages for HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS alongside SOC 2 and ISO 27001, plus CMMC and NIST 800-171, all within one compliance platform. Its MCP server also exposes frameworks as part of the same account's data model. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of cross-framework control mapping or reuse when adding a new framework, depth beyond marketing-level framework pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
